verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.coderabbit.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of links to markdown versions of doc pages. Many cited doc URLs are served as raw .md files, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also published, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-consumable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content bundle, and first-party documentation describing these agent-oriented docs or how to use them with agents.
